create_ssl_norm_transform: create an SSLNorm instance to get preconfigured image normalization transforms for self-supervised learning
build_custom_norm_transform: build a Norm instance and call get_trans with custom mean and std values for image normalization
apply_forward_transform: apply the Trans composed transform to convert and normalize an image tensor
apply_inverse_transform: apply the invTrans composed transform to denormalize a tensor back to original image values
review_norm_class: review the Norm class and its get_trans method for configuring forward and inverse image normalization
